recs.stt: The Sound So Loud That It Circled the Earth Four Times
recs.x:
f shuttle launches generally assume the guttural crackling, popping roar sound they hear is due to a badly adjusted microphone clipping the loud sounds. In fact, this was a physical phenomenon that could be heard in real life, due to the pressure waves physically "clipping" against a vacuum upon reaching the atmospheric pressure limit! Sorry I can't seem to find any better sources, but this is an anecdote I've heard from several witnesses: [link]
